new_results.statement: For a rank-one source bank S_H=lambda vv^T and a disjoint rank-two source bank S_G, if v^T Mv=0 and D=|det M| lambda det((P_v S_G P_v)|v^perp)>0, the conditioned and full quadratic law has a continuous density bounded by 12 D^{-1/3}.

If a nonzero physical Schur pivot a has such a residual, account04/B18 dependence-safe square smoothing gives essential density bound 4 sqrt(3) |a|^{-1/2} D^{-1/6}. Continuity is not claimed through this wrapper.

live_application: In account03/B19 r22 O3 grouped determinant exit, mu>=1/512 and D_j>=mu/4 imply D_j>=1/2048; exact null t=0 is bounded continuously by 96*2^(2/3)=152.39050098894714.
primary_source: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov arXiv:1507.07949, exact k-dimensional product marginal cap 2^(k/2).
literature_nontransfer: Kwan-Sauermann quadratic Littlewood-Offord point-probability theorem does not supply an O(epsilon) interval modulus and is not an exact prior solution of the density target.
remaining_gap: Interpolate the exact-null grouped estimate to small nonzero v^T Mv without perturbative deletion, or route that strip to the completed near-null projection-product branch; the global product-preserving compiler from s_3(A)>=1 remains open.
